hero.titleSmall: Not just a haircut, half an hour of quiet.
hero.lede: Fresh fades. Clean lines. Quiet confidence. We don't just cut your hair, we upgrade your style. Walk in ordinary, walk out unforgettable.

video.p: We don't rush. Every cut is considered, every line is drawn, every client leaves better than they arrived.

services.p: Honest prices, realistic timing, no surprises. Every service includes a facial cleanse and premium products.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.desc: Scissor and clipper cut, refreshing wash, facial cleanse and personalised styling.

items.title: Full Ritual (Hair & Beard)
items.desc: The essential package for gentlemen. Includes haircut, beard trim, facial cleanse and finish with premium products.

items.title: Family Tradition (Father & Son)
items.desc: A shared experience on side-by-side chairs. Full haircut and a style lesson for the next generation.

items.title: Simple Cut (Refresh)
items.desc: Clipper cut (minimum 3 mm). For the moments when you need a clean, essential refresh.

items.title: Simple Cut & Beard
items.desc: Short clipper cut paired with beard trim and hydrating products.

items.title: The Young Gentleman
items.desc: For our youngest clients. Patience, attention and a style cut to fit.

items.title: Beard Architecture
items.desc: Shape sculpting, razor contour, hydration and facial cleanse.

items.title: Refresh & Styling
items.desc: Wash, dry and professional styling. Ideal before an event or an important meeting.

items.title: House Indulgence (Full Experience)
items.desc: Craft without compromise: revitalising scalp massage, precision cut and beard architecture, accompanied by premium grooming products.

about.p1: The Men's Place opened in 2016 as an intimate workshop with just two chairs and a clear vision: absolute quality before volume. We chose not to rush time, but to turn every visit into a ritual of craft, giving today's man the distinction of times past.
about.pull: “A good haircut isn't a transaction, it's a pause. Half an hour when no one asks anything of you.”

items.name: Levente Ninacs
items.bio: 10 years of craft. From the rigour of the classic cut to the precision of modern style, we turn the beard into a piece of facial architecture. All scissors, passion and absolute attention to detail.

items.text: I walked in tired and walked out a gentleman. Levi is a true craftsman, every detail counts.
items.name: Gergő Z.

items.text: The best premium package in town. The atmosphere, the scent of the products, the music, everything is considered.
items.name: Dávid B.

items.text: I've been coming for four years and haven't tried anywhere else. The cut holds perfectly for three weeks, that says it all.
items.name: Răzvan I.

booking.p: Chairs fill up fast. Use the Mero app to check availability and book your moment.

footer.tagline: A classic barbershop for gentlemen who appreciate craft, time well spent and a haircut done right.
footer.madeWith: Made with patience in Satu Mare

privacy.metaDescription: How The Men's Place processes visitor data in line with the GDPR.

s1.body: {name}, with its registered office at {street}, {postal} {city}, {country}, phone <phone>{phoneDisplay}</phone>, is the controller of the personal data collected through this site.

s2.p1: Our site does not request personal data directly. There are no contact forms, accounts or shopping carts. Bookings are made exclusively through the external Mero platform.
s2.p2: This site does not use cookies, no tracking, analytics or advertising cookies. We do not use other local storage technologies (localStorage, pixels, fingerprinting) for profiling.
s2.li1: Anonymised traffic data via Vercel Analytics: page visited, country, device type, browser, referrer. The IP address is anonymised before storage; no cookies are set.
s2.li2: Strictly necessary technical data (server logs) to deliver the site and prevent abuse.

s3.body: Our services include packages for children (“The Young Gentleman”, “Family Tradition, Father & Son”). Bookings for minors are made exclusively by parents or legal guardians. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16 through this site (Art. 8 GDPR). If you become aware that a minor has provided us with such data, please contact us so we can delete it.

s4.body: We process this data on the basis of our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) of EU Regulation 2016/679, GDPR), in order to understand how the site is used and to improve it. We do not use the data for profiling, behavioural advertising or automated decision-making.

s5.body: When you click the “Book” button you are redirected to <mero>mero.ro</mero>. Mero becomes an independent controller for the data you enter there (name, phone, chosen time). Please consult <meroPriv>their privacy policy</meroPriv>.

s6.body: The site is hosted by Vercel Inc. (USA), acting as a processor on our behalf. Transfers to the USA are protected by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. We do not sell or share data with third parties for commercial purposes.

s7.body: The site is served exclusively over HTTPS (TLS) and runs on Vercel's secure infrastructure, with automatically managed certificates and network-level DDoS protection. We do not process or store payment data on this domain, transactions for services are settled physically at the salon. We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to prevent unauthorised access, alteration or disclosure of the data processed.

s8.body: Anonymised traffic data is kept for a maximum of 12 months. Technical logs are automatically deleted after 30 days.

s9.p1: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability and objection. To exercise these rights you can contact us at <phone>{phoneDisplay}</phone>.
s9.p2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP), <anspdcp>dataprotection.ro</anspdcp>.

s10.body: This policy may be updated. The current version is always available on this page, with the date of the last revision shown at the top.
